Tenor saxophonist Ralph LaLama was born in West Aliquippa, Pennsylvania on January 30, 1951. His big band experience includes stints with Buddy Rich, Woody Herman and the Vanguard Jazz Orchestra. Ralph has co-led a quartet with fellow saxophonist Joe Lovano and records as a leader on the Criss-Cross label.
Ralph was interviewed in Utica, New York on May 23, 2010 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and I am off-camera for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive, and I am very pleased to be speaking with saxophonist Ralph LaLama today. Welcome back to Utica, New York.
